title: Cute little cabinet, cheaply made
text: Cute little cabinet, cheaply made. This is a cute little cabinet and surprisingly roomy for it's size. Was not difficult the put together if you've put together cheap furniture before. The price was reasonable. I am using it to replace a much larger cabinet in my small bathroom. Looks nice but time will tell how long it lasts. The back of it is made of cardboard! Decent value for the money though and looks nice. The only reason it didn't get more stars is because it is made of cheap press pressboard and cardboard. A decent value for the money though.

product_metadata.title: Sauder Caraway Floor Cabinet, Soft White finish
features: Gallery top with faux slate finish
Frame and panel door with bead board insert
Reversible door opens left or right
Soft White finish with Slate finish accent
description: Stylish storage where you need it. This floor cabinet from the Sauder Bath collection is the solution to your storage needs. Behind its frame and panel door is an adjustable shelf so you can store all your bathroom necessities. There is also an open shelf for additional storage. It features a spacious faux slate gallery tabletop. Finished in Soft White, this cabinet adds style and functionality to your bathroom.
